gap: Kill the raster country flag in the desktop language switcher. It is the only muddy multi-colour object in an otherwise purely typographic nav bar, it renders as ~20px of red/blue noise beside clean navy text, and a UK flag standing for 'English' is a credibility smell on a product whose own headline is 'the ERP that speaks your language' (the flag names a country, not a language, and the Arabic state of it will be worse). Replace it with a text-only control set in the nav's own type: a globe glyph or just 'EN' with the chevron, same weight and colour as 'Log in', and separate the right-hand cluster from the link row with a hairline or a wider gap so the header reads as two groups, not five loose objects.
